name: Smalltalk

runtimes.name: Cog VM (Pharo / Squeak)
runtimes.role: Bytecode VM with a JIT for hot methods, running a live object image.

compilers.name: Image compiler
compilers.role: Compiles methods to bytecode live inside the running image.

concurrencyModel: Implementation-level lightweight processes scheduled within an image and sharing objects. Smalltalk message sends are method dispatch; inter-process coordination uses facilities such as semaphores and shared queues.

codeExample.source:
| greeting |
greeting := 'Hello, World!'.
Transcript show: greeting; cr.
1 to: 10 do: [:i | Transcript show: i printString; cr].
